verdict.rationale: Twenty documents auto-generated API documentation per workspace for both GraphQL and REST, with an interactive playground that executes real calls against your data. That covers exploring an interactive API reference with runnable examples. The OpenAPI probe 404s are on docs.twenty.com paths, which doesn't contradict per-workspace generated docs. Missing for 10: detail on the playground's example content (prebuilt snippets, language samples), a public static API reference/OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the playground.
